Name: Wallet Scepter
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
This mod makes the Return Scepter a Wallet item freeing up an inventory slot. This has several options. It can take you home at 1am or even send you right to bed instead. 

If you have a mod that adds warp locations this mod will trigger them as normal as long as the mod adding warp locations is activated by the normal scepter. It is also compatible with mods that retexture the Scepter.

The Hotkey is Left Ctrl + S an is configurable along with a few other options. 

It is also compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url].

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]
